questions.question: How long (in years) will a sum of money invested at 6% per annum simple interest to increase its value by 40%?
questions.solution:
Given:

Rate of interest = 6%

The principal will be increased its value by 40%

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

Let,T = time and principal (P) = 100 

The simple interest got by the person is 40

As per the formula,

40 = 100 × 6 × T / 100

⇒ T = 40 /6

⇒ 20/3years = 6(2)/(3) years

∴ The correct option is 1

questions.question: Suhas, a 3.15 m tall tree, and an 11.25 m tall building are positioned such that their feet on the ground are collinear and the tree is located between Suhas and the building. The tree is located at a distance of 45 m from the building. Further, the eyes of Suhas, the top of the tree, and the top of the building fall in one line, and the eyes of Suhas are at a height of 1.8 m from the ground. At what distance (in m) from Suhas is the tree located?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of Suhas' eyesight = 1.8 m

Height of tree = 3.15 m

Height of building = 11.25 m

Distance between building and tree = 45 m

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ab9dbed1b97a7a7f02c8133eb4bc58cdc05c549854003825197401f0d246536.png] 

From the figure,

TU = BE = 45 m

AS = DT = 1.8 m

⇒ BD = BT - DT = 3.15 - 1.8 = 1.35 m

BT = EU = 3.15 m

⇒ CE = CU - EU = 11.25 - 3.15 = 8.1 m

According to the question, the eyes of Suhas, the top of the tree, and the top of the building fall in one line

⇒ ∠BAD = ∠CBE ----(1)

Also, ∠BDA = ∠CEB = 90° ----(2)

From (1) and (2), ΔABD and ΔBCE are similar triangles

⇒ AD/BD = BE/CE

⇒ AD/1.35 = 45/8.1

⇒ AD = (45/8.1) × 1.35

⇒ AD = 7.5 m

Now, AD = ST = 7.5

**∴ The tree is located at a distance of 7.5 meters from Suhas.**

questions.question: A can finish a work in 15 days, B can finish the same work in 25 days. They work together for 5 days. The rest of the work is finished by A and C in 4 days. Then C alone can finish the work in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 15 and 25 = 75 units.

Efficiency of A = 75 ÷ 15 = 5, Efficiency of B = 75 ÷ 25 = 3.

Work done by A and B in 5 days = 5 × (5 + 3) = 40 units.

Remaining work = 75 − 40 = 35 units.

Combined efficiency of A and C = 35 ÷ 4 = 8.75 units/day.

Efficiency of C = 8.75 − 5 = 3.75. Time taken by C = 75 ÷ 3.75 = 20 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 15 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 25 days

A and B work together for 5 days.

Remaining work is completed by A and C in 4 days.

**Calculations:**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A

⇒ Work completed by A and B in 5 days = 5 × (5 + 3) = 40 units

⇒ Remaining work = Total work − Completed work = 75 − 40 = 35 units

⇒ A and C complete this remaining work in 4 days.

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and C = Remaining work ÷ Time = 35 ÷ 4 = 35/4 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = Combined efficiency of (A + C) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of C = 35/4 − 5 = (35 − 20) / 4 = 15/4 units/day

⇒ Time taken by C alone = Total work ÷ Efficiency of C = 75 ÷ (15/4) = 75 × (4/15) = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total Work is typically taken as the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) of the given individual time periods. Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken.

Efficiency and Time Relationship

The efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to the time taken by them to complete a piece of work. If the ratio of time taken is a:b, their efficiency ratio will be b:a.

Chain Rule (Group Work)

If M₁ men can do W₁ work in D₁ days working H₁ hours per day, and M₂ men can do W₂ work in D₂ days working H₂ hours per day, then (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.
